4364-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Move to your next turn. Optionally, you can instead give Massimo haste.
Declare Massimo and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.
4364-4598-8330.notes: You can also do this combo in one turn if you give the ability to a creature that has haste (excluding Aurelia) instead. If you give the ability to another creature, you will need to cause that creature to enter, target the creature with Massimo, and then replace Massimo in the combat phase with the creature. If you do this in one turn, either with Massimo or another creature, ensure that Aurelia has not attacked during that turn.

2034-7841--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Darksteel Angel
Repeat.

2023-4289-4518-6968.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4742-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3151-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Elvish Archdruid has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3151-4613-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3220-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3220-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

586-3899-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

728-4871-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-4871-5220-5243.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

240-955-4247-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7934.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

301-4738-6461.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

206-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
206-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4186-6720-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6720-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-2079-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2079-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2097-4871-5626.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
2097-4871-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
2097-4871-5626.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

997-5671-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1753-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

339-677-4050-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1778-5220-5330-6900.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-3122.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Undercover Operative.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Undercover Operative by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-5147-5223.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3767-3918-5116-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1256-5499-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-5499-6633.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1692-5330-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-5330-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-5330-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

3604-4779-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
3604-4779-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3604-4779-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1170-2733-4826-5921-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

151-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-5803.description:
Cast To Arms! by paying {1}{W}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying To Arms!.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

625-2743-4483.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
625-2743-4483.description:
Activate Ashnod's Transmogrant by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Biovisionary to become an artifact.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1651-2034-2797-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1651-2034-2797-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

224-643-2366-3346-5220.notablePrerequisites: Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
224-643-2366-3346-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability from step 1, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Bog Glider.
Repeat.

1636-3621-4331-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3621-4331-4659.description:
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

567-1274-3197.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-1274-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

224-1772-3147-4826.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

987-2724-4991.notablePrerequisites: Shadow Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
987-2724-4991.description:
Tap Shadow Guildmage for {U} to put Wormfang Manta on top of your library.
Wormfang Manta's LTB triggers, granting you an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Whisperwood Elemental triggers, manifesting Wormfang Manta.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn it face up.
Repeat for infinite turns.
